claims.assertion: Mari says consciousness and interpretation define personal realms; shared realms arise from perceptual agreements, so physical laws are not universal.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

claims.assertion: She says higher-realm beings of light may appear as ordinary people, animals or objects, guiding less perceptive beings and expanding their consciousness.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

claims.assertion: Such beings can manifest across distances and through several bodies at once, treating physical rules as optional constraints they follow to be perceived.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

coverage_gaps: other claims about ethics and selfhood omitted
